name: CATT_benchmark_predictions_Gemma3_1b_v3-colorful-oath-17-2048
description: A dataset of model predictions produced by the Gemma3_1b_v3 model on the CATT "colorful-oath-17-2048" evaluation set. It captures model responses to prompts intended to probe instruction-following and safety/alignment behavior and is intended for comparative analysis of model outputs. Primarily used to analyze failure modes and alignment performance rather than to provide a standalone human-validated benchmark.
reputation: Limited community adoption; appears to be a predictions artifact for model analysis rather than a widely used independent benchmark.
